text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to understand and interpret visual information from the world. Two key tasks in computer vision are image recognition and object detection. Image recognition allows a computer to identify what is in a photo, such as a cat or a tree. Object detection goes a step further by locating where objects are in an image. These technologies have many practical applications, from medical imaging to security systems. Perhaps most famously, computer vision is essential for self-driving cars, which use cameras and sensors to detect pedestrians, traffic signs, and other vehicles, making real-time decisions to navigate safely.
